candidates.title: Quarterly Business Reviews
candidates.description: Reports showing totals of gross business income, state and local taxable retail sales, public utility taxes, and other taxes reported on combined excise tax returns. Industries are identified by Standard Industrial Classification (SIC) and North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) codes. SIC data is only available from 1990-2004 and NAICS data from 1994-present. In a report builder interface, users can select a quarterly or annual time period, a county or city location, and the type of data required. Reports are generated in either HTML or an Excel spreadsheet.  PDFs are also available that provide a compilation of statistics on gross income, taxable retail sales, and accrued tax liability.  This is based on the same data used in the report builder.  Tables showing taxable sales for counties and cities by industry (NAICS) are only available through the report builder).

candidates.title: Asotin County Library District Revenues, 2019 to Present
candidates.description: This dataset reports annual operating revenues for the Asotin County (WA) Library District. The Library District reports figures annually to the Public Libraries Survey administered by the Washington State Library in cooperation with the U. S. Institure of Museum and Library Services (IMLS). Data reflects actual figures reported during the particular year and are not adjusted for inflation. For a detailed glossary of terms and more information about the survey, visit the Statistics page at the Washington State Library: https://www.sos.wa.gov/library/libraries/libdev/publications.aspx#WAStats.
